page.notes: The running head reads "INDEX LIB. I." and is set above the decorative rule. The title block "INCIPIVNT RVBRICÆ libri primi." is partly italic. Some entries are cut at the column break, and the text of the left column's last entry "Testimonia sanctorū de tri-" continues into the right column as "nitate." The page has no page number. Entries such as "ibid.D" are reference letters kept as printed. The column break in the left column ends with a hyphenated word "tri-" which is completed by "nitate." at the top of the right column; the entry was placed in the list in printed order.
